introduction: WOOKTOOL promotional plastic measuring tapes are for branded campaigns, hardware promotions and value-focused wholesale programs. Buyers can plan a product around logo visibility, color, pack format and expected order quantity.
For an accurate quote, provide the campaign market, quantity, desired measuring format, logo artwork, color reference and package direction.

faq.question: Can promotional tape measures use a custom logo?
faq.answer: Yes. Logo, shell color, label treatment and package artwork can be reviewed for the selected model.

faq.question: What information is needed for a promotional quote?
faq.answer: Share the intended market, quantity, measuring format, artwork, packaging and requested delivery date.

faq.question: Can these be supplied for retail displays?
faq.answer: Retail packaging, barcodes, display direction and carton marks can be discussed with the factory.

faq.question: What quality points are reviewed?
faq.answer: The factory can check logo appearance, blade printing, readability, retraction, hook function, packing quantity and carton marks.
